scope: Reuse Launchpad label layouts during scrolling and adaptive tint updates.

checks.command: Qt Quick letter-scope fixture, 1500 movements. Layout calls fell from 1502 to 1. The serialized markup and gradient data matched at every position. Median time per 300 moves fell from 30 to 22 ms.

coverage_limits: The CPU benchmark covers label geometry and painting data. It does not measure desktop or game FPS.
